content: 2026 best practice test stack: Vitest (unit + component), fastify.inject/light-my-request (built into Fastify, exercises full plugin lifecycle without opening a socket) for API/integration tests, @vue/test-utils (official, recommended over @testing-library/vue for Suspense-heavy Vue 3 apps) for component testing, Playwright for E2E of critical flows. DB integration strategy: testcontainers-node spins up ephemeral Postgres per test run/worker; common pattern to avoid Vitest parallel-worker collisions is either one container per worker (via globalSetup provide/inject) or transaction-per-test rollback for speed.
